posts.title: We're blowing up lead in Iowa?
posts.description: There's a ton of outrage and fear about the military's plan to blow up five tons of unstable lead azide in Iowa, so I'm thankful for high-quality journalism like this from the New York Times that explains what the hell is going on. Update : Seems like it went OK? U.S. Environmental Protection Agency air monitors were detecting no lead in the air around the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown.

posts.title: Comments and emails by Herman
posts.description: Herman writes about why Bear Blog has a default policy of no built-in comments. I appreciate this stance. I also agree with him here about anonymity: Anonymous notes are the worst kind to receive. There's nobody to reply to, nothing to block, and the perpetrator doesn't have a social incentive to behave. I have more thoughts on being anonymous online, but that's for another day.

posts.title: CJ Rosser committing to UNC
posts.description: A few weeks ago UNC landed Demarcus Henry and today they get CJ Rosser . The No. 2 & 3 players in the 2027 class. Amazing pulls. Let Michael Malone cook. We've got the top recruiting class in the country now. Honestly, just pull the plug on the football program and put everything into hoops.
